name: Machine element, fastener, fixing, mounting
definition: machine element, fastener, fixing, mounting encompasses a wide range of products used for the manufacturing and maintenance of machines, equipment, and devices, as well as for the construction and assembly of buildings and building equipment. this includes elements such as screws, nuts, bolts, rivets, machine and control elements, wood connection elements, fittings, and anchors, as well as linear motion technology. these parts are essential for the structural integrity and functionality of various systems and are used in industries such as mechanical engineering, plant engineering, vehicle manufacturing, construction, and technical building equipment.

name: Electric engineering, automation, process control engineering
definition: this classification encompasses all aspects related to the design, development, implementation, and management of electronic systems and processes aimed at enhancing control and automation in various applications. It includes devices, technologies, and methodologies that facilitate the regulation and monitoring of processes, ensuring efficiency and reliability in operations. The scope covers components and systems used in electrical engineering, emphasizing automation technologies, process control solutions, and related services. This classification differentiates itself by its focus on the integration of electrical components with automated systems, providing solutions for a wide range of industries that require sophisticated control mechanisms and process optimization. The aim is to support advancements in technology that lead to improved productivity and operational effectiveness.

name: Semifinished product
definition: prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form. It usually consists of a single raw material, which has been brought into a basic geometric shape. Semi-finished products are, for example, simple profiles, rods, tubes and plates made of metal, plastic or wood. A semi-finished product is an incompletely finished product that can be further processed into a finished product

name: Industrial piping
definition: Segment includes the design and manufacture of piping systems used for the transportation of liquids, gases and sometimes solids in various industrial and commercial applications. This includes pipes, fittings, flanges, valves and supporting control systems. Not included are the pipes and installation elements that are installed in buildings that are not used for industrial applications. These can be found in subject area 22.

name: Optics
definition: Segment includes products and technologies that deal with the generation, manipulation and detection of light. This includes optical instruments such as microscopes, telescopes, cameras and glasses, optical components such as lenses, prisms and mirrors as well as laser technology and photonic systems. Other products with a focus on electrical engineering are not included in this subject area but are part of segment 27.

name: Fluid power
definition: area of drive technology, which uses transmission, control, regulation and transfer from energy by a liquid or gaseous pressure fluid to solve drive functions

name: Machine handle
definition: Component of machines and devices which is used for operating, setting, opening and closing, as well as setting up and adjusting or leveling

name: Shaft, shaft joint
definition: rod-shaped machine part for the transmission of mechanical energy and component for flexible connection of shafts

name: Coupling (non-electric)
definition: this category encompasses a variety of components designed to connect or link two or more parts of machinery or equipment without the use of electrical systems. These items facilitate the transfer of motion, torque, or force between connected elements, ensuring efficient operation and alignment. The classification includes various types of couplings that differ in their mechanical properties and applications, providing solutions for rigid connections, flexible engagements, and torque management. The components in this category are essential for enhancing the functionality and reliability of mechanical systems, allowing for effective assembly and disassembly as needed. Furthermore, these items may incorporate additional features such as measuring sensors or overload protection to enhance performance and safety in applications across diverse industries.

name: Brake
definition: this classification encompasses devices designed to slow down or halt motion in mechanical systems through various means. It includes components that utilize friction, electrical energy, or fluid dynamics to achieve braking effects. The devices categorized here facilitate safety and control in machinery and vehicles by providing reliable stopping power. They are integral to the operation of countless applications, ensuring stability and performance while preventing unintended movement. The classification further distinguishes between types of braking mechanisms based on their operational principles, such as those utilizing mechanical forces, electrical energy, or hydraulic fluids. Each of these categories serves specific functions and applications, highlighting the diversity of braking technologies in various industrial and commercial contexts.

name: Rolling bearing, plain bearing, spherical plain bearing
definition: this category encompasses various supporting elements designed to facilitate motion and reduce friction between moving parts in mechanical systems. It includes devices that allow for rotational or linear movement while providing stability and alignment. The offerings are characterized by their ability to bear loads and enhance the operational efficiency of machinery. The classification covers products that are integral to the assembly and function of larger mechanical units, ensuring smooth operation and durability. Additionally, it includes components that are essential for the maintenance, assembly, and disassembly of these bearing systems, thereby supporting their longevity and performance in various industrial applications.

name: Lubrication, coolant, lubricating device
definition: this classification encompasses products and solutions related to the application and management of lubricants and coolants used in various machinery and equipment. It includes substances and devices designed to reduce friction, enhance performance, and protect surfaces from wear and corrosion. The focus is on items that facilitate smooth operation by providing necessary lubrication to moving parts, as well as those that offer thermal regulation or preservation. This category also covers agents that prevent freezing, enhance the life of components through protective coatings, and specialized devices for the effective application of these substances. The intention is to ensure optimal functioning and longevity of machinery through effective lubrication and cooling solutions.

name: Seal
definition: this classification pertains to a category of components that create barriers to fluid or gas flow, ensuring containment and preventing leaks in various applications. These elements are designed to fit between two or more surfaces to provide a secure seal, which is essential in both mechanical and structural contexts. The items in this category serve diverse functions, including but not limited to, protecting machinery and systems from contaminants, maintaining pressure, and enhancing operational efficiency. They come in various shapes, materials, and designs to suit specific requirements and applications, providing reliable performance in demanding environments. This classification distinctly excludes components related to control, mounting, or fastening mechanisms, focusing solely on those that fulfill sealing functions.

name: Spring
definition: this classification encompasses a category of elastic elements designed to store and release mechanical energy. These components are characterized by their ability to undergo deformation under load and return to their original shape when the load is removed. The specific types within this category include elements that primarily generate force through compression, extension, or torsion. The classification also distinguishes between various forms and applications of these elastic elements, each suited for different mechanical functions and requirements in machinery and equipment. These components play a critical role in various applications, providing support, resilience, and energy management in mechanical systems.

name: Washer, ring, supporting element
definition: this classification pertains to a category of components designed to provide support and distribution of loads in mechanical assemblies. The elements in this category typically serve to enhance the functionality and reliability of fastening systems. They are utilized to create a stable interface between parts, helping to prevent wear and ensuring proper alignment within various applications. These components are distinguished by their specific shapes, materials, and intended uses, which can vary widely depending on the requirements of the assembly they are a part of. They are integral to maintaining the integrity and performance of machinery and equipment across diverse industries.

name: Pin, linch pin, wedge
definition: this classification encompasses a variety of fasteners specifically designed for securing and connecting components within mechanical systems. Items in this category are distinguished by their structural characteristics and functional applications, serving essential roles in assembly and maintenance tasks. These fasteners are utilized to provide stability and ensure the proper alignment of parts, often allowing for easy installation and removal. The classification includes various forms of pins, such as cylindrical and conical types, as well as specialized connectors like linch pins and spring-type pins. Additionally, it covers key components that facilitate effective joining and spacing, ensuring efficient operation and durability in mechanical assemblies. The items within this classification are crucial for maintaining the integrity and functionality of various machinery and equipment.

name: Screw, nut
definition: this classification encompasses fastening components designed for mechanical assembly and connection purposes, characterized by their ability to secure or join two or more parts together. Items in this category typically exhibit features such as various thread types, shapes, and materials, allowing them to perform effectively in diverse applications. These components are essential for structural integrity and operational functionality in machinery and equipment. The classification distinctly focuses on those items that provide reusable or permanent connections and may include variants optimized for specific materials or environmental conditions. Additionally, this category supports a range of applications, reflecting the versatility and critical role of fastening elements in engineering and manufacturing processes.

name: Pin, nail, hook, rivet
definition: this classification encompasses a variety of fastening elements designed to join or secure materials together. It includes items that provide support, alignment, or connection in various applications. The classification features devices that can penetrate or affix to surfaces, utilized in construction, manufacturing, and repair tasks. The elements within this classification range from simple, single-point fasteners to more complex assemblies that may involve multiple components. Each item serves a specific purpose, contributing to the overall integrity and functionality of constructions or mechanisms. This classification is distinct from other fastening methods and components, focusing specifically on items that serve as connectors or stabilizers in various contexts.

name: Turnbuckle, rope, assembly component
definition: this classification encompasses assembly components specifically designed for tensioning applications, typically involving the adjustment and securing of cables or ropes. These components facilitate the connection and stabilization of various structures or systems, allowing for precise control over tension and alignment. The classification differentiates itself by focusing on elements that are integral to the assembly and adjustment processes in mechanical contexts, without overlapping with other categories related to control mechanisms, joint connections, or fastening systems. Items within this classification are characterized by their role in enhancing structural integrity and operational efficiency in a wide range of applications, emphasizing their importance in mechanical assemblies.

name: Pipe-/Tubeclamp
definition: this category encompasses devices designed to securely hold or support pipes, hoses, or tubes in various applications. These components are integral in ensuring stability and alignment within systems that require fluid or gas transportation, mechanical connections, or structural integrity. The items within this classification are characterized by their ability to accommodate different sizes and materials, providing flexibility in installation and use. They are manufactured to withstand varying environmental conditions and mechanical stresses, making them suitable for industrial, commercial, and domestic applications. This classification is distinguished by its focus on fastening technologies specifically tailored for cylindrical objects, differentiating it from other fastening devices that serve different functional purposes.

name: Anchor, dowel, direct fastening
definition: Single-part or multi-part fastening aid, which is usually used to fasten components directly to walls, ceilings or floors or, with the aid of other joining or fastening elements and/or processing equipment, to create the prerequisites for fixing or fastening components

name: Aerial line fastening
definition: this classification encompasses fastening components designed specifically for securing aerial lines. These elements are integral to the assembly and maintenance of overhead installations, ensuring stability and safety in various applications. They may include various types of fasteners, mounts, and supporting structures that cater to the unique requirements of aerial systems. The focus is on components that facilitate the attachment, alignment, and support of aerial lines, providing the necessary strength and durability to withstand environmental conditions. This classification distinguishes itself from other fastening components by emphasizing those specifically engineered for aerial applications, thereby addressing the unique challenges and specifications associated with overhead systems.

name: Toothed part and drive
definition: this category encompasses components designed for the transfer of motion and power through mechanical means, characterized by their interlocking features or specific driving mechanisms. It includes elements that facilitate the engagement and transmission of force between parts, ensuring efficient operation within various machinery and equipment. The focus is on parts that utilize teeth or similar structures to enhance connectivity and drive functionalities. Components in this classification are integral to the functioning of systems that rely on precise motion control and energy transfer, serving applications across diverse industries where reliable and effective mechanical interactions are essential.

name: Vibration damper
definition: a vibration damper is a device designed to reduce or eliminate oscillations and vibrations in mechanical systems. It functions by dissipating energy generated by motion, thereby enhancing the stability and longevity of machinery and structures. This component is essential in applications where excessive movements can lead to damage or inefficiency, ensuring smoother operation and improved performance. Vibration dampers can be employed in various industries, including automotive, aerospace, and manufacturing, and may utilize different materials and technologies to achieve the desired damping effect. Their design considerations often involve factors such as load capacity, frequency response, and environmental conditions, making them vital for maintaining the integrity of mechanical assemblies.

name: Lock (door and gate)
definition: this classification encompasses devices specifically designed to secure and control access to doors and gates. These mechanisms are integral to the functionality and safety of entry points in various environments. The classification includes complete locking systems as well as individual components that contribute to the locking mechanism. It covers both mounted and unmounted options, offering flexibility for installation in different applications. Additionally, it includes lock cylinders, which are specialized components that facilitate key-based access control. Various elements involved in the assembly and operation of these locks, ensuring robust security measures for residential, commercial, and industrial settings, are also represented.

name: Fitting (door, gate)
definition: this classification encompasses various components designed for the installation and operation of doors and gates. These elements facilitate the movement, security, and structural integrity of entry points in both residential and commercial settings. The classification includes items that ensure proper alignment, functionality, and safety of doors and gates, addressing mechanisms that enable smooth operation and secure closure. It also covers accessories that enhance the performance and aesthetic appeal of these access points. Each component serves a specific role in the assembly and operation of door and gate systems, ranging from hardware that supports physical movement to security features that protect premises. This categorization provides a comprehensive overview of essential fittings used in various architectural and construction applications.

name: Hinge (door, gate)
definition: this classification encompasses mechanical devices designed to facilitate the movement of doors and gates by connecting them to a stationary frame. These devices allow for pivoting motion, enabling the opening and closing of the door or gate. Typically constructed from durable materials to withstand repeated use, they can vary in design, size, and load-bearing capacity, catering to different applications and structural requirements. The category includes various types of hinges specifically tailored for enhancing functionality, security, and aesthetic appeal in architectural elements. Elements within this classification are essential for ensuring smooth operation and stability in access points, whether in residential, commercial, or industrial settings.

name: Door closer
definition: this classification encompasses devices designed to control the closing mechanism of doors, ensuring they return to a fully closed position after being opened. These mechanisms are essential for maintaining security, energy efficiency, and accessibility in various environments. The devices may vary in their operational design and application, catering to different door configurations. Key variations include those specifically engineered for single or double offset hung doors, as well as pendulum doors, each addressing unique functional requirements. Additionally, this classification includes specialized release devices that facilitate controlled door closure, enhancing usability and safety in both residential and commercial settings.

name: Window fitting
definition: this classification encompasses a category dedicated to components specifically designed for the installation, operation, and enhancement of window systems. It includes items that facilitate the movement and security of windows, as well as elements that contribute to their functionality and aesthetic appeal. The components within this category are essential for ensuring that windows operate smoothly and securely, while also providing necessary features such as ventilation and safety measures. This classification distinctly focuses on products that are integral to the effective functioning of window structures, setting them apart from other mechanical and fastening elements. The items classified here include various fittings, hinges, handles, and specialized components tailored for both standard and French window applications, along with systems designed for smoke and heat control.

name: Furniture fitting
definition: this classification encompasses various elements specifically designed for enhancing the functionality, aesthetics, and structural integrity of furniture. It includes components that facilitate the operation of furniture, such as locking mechanisms and sliding systems, as well as decorative and functional fittings that contribute to the overall design. Additionally, it covers systems that ensure smooth movement and accessibility of drawers and doors, along with connectors that join different parts of furniture together. The focus is on items that are integral to the assembly, operation, and presentation of various types of furniture, catering to both practical and stylistic needs in interior design.

name: Linear motion technology, Rotary systems
definition: linear motion technology and rotary systems describe a subdiscipline of drive technology that deals with mechanical components or mechatronic systems for performing translational and rotational movements. it encompasses mechanical components that enable precise, straight-line motion — independent of complex handling systems or robotic solutions. this includes, in particular, linear guides, guide carriages, ball screw drives, linear bearings, spindles, and linear actuators. these components are integrated as individual parts into machines and systems to achieve repeatable, highly precise linear movements with high load capacity.

name: Spindle
definition: this classification encompasses components specifically designed to facilitate rotational movement or transfer of energy within machinery. These elements are integral to various mechanical systems, ensuring precision and efficiency in operations. The focus is on parts that support the attachment or integration of tools and implements, allowing for dynamic interaction with other machine components. The classification also distinguishes between types based on their operational characteristics, such as those driven by external forces compared to those that are motorized. This ensures a comprehensive understanding of the functions and applications of these components in diverse industrial contexts.

name: Gear unit for industrial application
definition: a gearbox is a mechanical system used to control torque transmission and rotational speed between a drive and a load in industrial applications.

name: Adhesive
definition: Process material that is used for bonding

name: Roller
definition: this classification encompasses components primarily designed to facilitate movement or support in various applications, often characterized by their cylindrical shape. These elements are integral in numerous mechanical systems, serving functions such as reducing friction, guiding motion, or enabling the transfer of force. They are commonly employed in both industrial and commercial settings, playing a crucial role in the efficiency and functionality of machinery and equipment. The classification includes items that vary in size, material, and design, ensuring versatility across different sectors. This category distinctly excludes elements associated with control mechanisms, fastening devices, or those intended for direct attachment or structural support.

name: Profile assembly system, structure system
definition: a system designed for the assembly and integration of structural components, which provides a framework for the construction and connection of various elements. This system facilitates the organization and support of profiles, enabling efficient assembly while ensuring structural integrity and functionality. It encompasses various types of components specifically tailored for connecting, joining, and enhancing the surface characteristics of the assembly. The classification includes essential elements that serve to establish stable connections, align structures, and provide necessary interfaces for mounting and supporting additional components. This system is integral to the creation of robust frameworks used in a wide range of applications, allowing for modular constructions that can be adapted to diverse operational requirements.

name: Wheel and roller
definition: this classification encompasses various items designed to facilitate movement and support within mechanical systems. It includes components that enable rotation, such as wheels, rollers, and casters, which are essential for load-bearing and mobility applications. The focus is on non-automotive engineering solutions, highlighting elements that provide stability, maneuverability, and ease of transport. This classification also covers specialized tires and castors designed for furniture, ensuring functionality in diverse environments. Each item within this classification serves a distinct purpose, contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of mechanical and structural designs.

name: Rotor and flowguide component
definition: this classification encompasses components that play a crucial role in guiding and controlling the flow of fluids or air within various systems, primarily focusing on the dynamic aspects of machinery and equipment. It includes items engineered to enhance performance, efficiency, and reliability in operational contexts. The elements classified here are integral to the functionality of machines, facilitating movement and interaction between different parts. This classification distinctly separates these components from those involved in control mechanisms, structural supports, or fasteners, emphasizing their unique applications and characteristics. The focus is on items that directly influence flow dynamics and motion, ensuring optimal operation in a variety of mechanical settings.

name: Door opener
definition: this classification encompasses devices designed to facilitate the opening and closing of doors, enabling access and enhancing security. These devices may operate manually or automatically and are integral to various entry systems in residential, commercial, and industrial settings. The classification includes mechanisms that engage with door hardware, ensuring smooth operation and reliable performance. It distinguishes between electronic and mechanical variants, highlighting their specific functionalities and applications. Additionally, it covers components that support the installation and operation of door opening systems, ensuring compatibility with diverse door types and designs. This classification serves to categorize items based on their operational context and integration within door systems.

name: Wood/timber connection
definition: this classification encompasses elements designed for the joining and securing of wooden components in various applications. It includes items that facilitate the reliable connection of timber structures, ensuring stability and strength. This category features a range of fasteners and connectors specifically engineered for wood, such as dowels, screws, and specialized joining systems. The focus is on products that enhance the integrity of wooden assemblies, catering to both structural and aesthetic requirements. This classification is distinct from other categories that involve mechanical components or fastening systems not primarily associated with wooden materials.

name: Generator
definition: electrical generator is a machine which dissipates kinetic energy or mechanical energy into electrical energy. A generator is based on the principle of electro-magnetic induction and is used for the generating the electrical alternating current. Generators of direct current, also called DC machines, produce direct current because of the detection of the alternating current. Main group 27010000 is structured on the basis of electrical power which is produced by generators and measured in megavolt-ampere. One exception are the generators which produce traction current with only monophasic voltage. They generate an alternating current of 16 2/3 Hertz instead of the usual 50 Hertz. Furthermore there is a differentiation in the groups between the components of the generators (exciter facilities and others), their mounting, service, inspection and maintenance

name: Electrical drive
definition: electrical drive is a drive with an electrical engine which is operated by an automatic control. Electrical energy is converted into mechanical kinetic energy, thereof the reverse principle of the electrical generator applies. The resulting kinetic energy exists as linear or rotary movement. The efficiency factor, the relation from submitted to supplied power, continues to grow up to 99% with the increase of the power. Main group 27020000 is structured by the classification of the electric drives according to their function principle and the specification of the operating input energy and its transformation into other appropriate forms. Furthermore there is a differentiation between control electronics and regulation electronics in particular and the assembly, service, inspection and maintenance of the electric drives in general

name: Transformer, converter, coil
definition: transformer is a structural component (mains transformer) or a facility (transformer station) which is used for the increase or the reduction of alternating currents. Converters pertain to the technical appliances for converting physical quantities, i.e. assembly groups which change electric potentials or circuits which convert between different electrical quantities. A coil is part of a technical inductance, i.e. an inductive passive structural component, e.g. a transformer. Main group 27030000 is structured by the fields of application and measurements of different transformers as well as method and capacity of their electrical transmission. Another section is reserved for the Petersen coils. Furthermore there is a differentiation between components and accessories of the transformers, their assembly, service, inspection and maintenance

name: Power supply device
definition: electricity supply or current supply covers all devices and functions which are necessary for the supply of electrical energy to the consumers. The supply includes the generation, the transport and the commerce of electricity. Main group 27040000 is structured according to the devices and equipments to transform alternating current and direct current or AC and DC voltage, units from combustion engines and generators for independent current supply (emergency power units) and modules for installation into the feeders intended to provide warranty for an uninterruptible electric power supply of critical electric load (USVs). Components, accessories, maintenance , inspection and service of the devices for power supply form further groups

name: Accumulator, battery
definition: Main group 27050000 classifies accumulators and batteries according to different specifications for various application areas and functions. Another group contains devices for charging of accumulators which are equipped with a more or less complex electronic charging circuit for the controlling of the charging process. The further classification is structured according to components , accessories, inspection and service of accumulators and batteries

name: Cable, wire
definition: cable is defined as an interconnection of wires (conductors), coated with a shrouded insulation casing or optical conductors which fulfils a homogeneous cross-section profile. Cables transfer energy or information, they often contain further inner cladding layer consisting of insulating material. Wires consist of electrically conducting materials, e.g. copper or aluminium, they are part of an electrical circuit and connect the power source and the consumers. Main group 27060000 is structured according to the transported media energy, data and light waves as well as the combination of those media (hybrid cable). The media are furthermore divided according to size, form, use, special usage and packaging. Another differentiation is done according to components , accessories, inspection and service of cables and wires

name: Medium voltage switchgear, system
definition: switchboard plant is a unit where electrical energy is distributed and transformed. MV-switching devices make up the connection points of a medium voltage network and are used for power distribution and combining of loads or consumer loads. Switchboards plants enable the modification of the network topology in case of disturbance and the isolating and earthing of the operating materials in case of maintenance work. Switchboards for medium voltage plants are usually engineered as central control rooms or cells in enclosed buildings. Main group 27070000 is structured into MS- switchboards and their operating equipment like special switches. Moreover components and accessories of the MV-switchboard and the MV-gear is displayed separately

name: High voltage switchgear, system
definition: switchboard is a unit where electrical energy is distributed and transformed. HV-switching devices make up the connection points of a high voltage network and are used for power distribution and combining of loads or consumer loads. Switchboards plants enable the modification of the network topology in case of disturbance and the isolating and earthing of the operating materials in case of maintenance work. Switchboards for high voltage are usually engineered as an open air switch gear or as a gas-insulated switch gear. Main group 27080000 is structured into HV- switch gears and their equipment like various switches, insulators and post insulators or isolaters. Moreover components and accessories of the HV-switchboard and the HV-gear is displayed separately

name: Power quality management
definition: Longlasting improvement action of network quality

name: Network control technology
definition: Network control technology can be summarised under the heading MSR(german)/ MCT (measurement and control technology). Network control technology is used to monitor and control networks, this includes electrical nets, water distribution nets, gas nets or heat grids. The transfer of process information to a central control base, the user-friendly preparation and display as well as the issue of the control commands to the process in the opposite direction are the main features of that technology. Main group 27100000 is divided into devices for the recording, transfer, synchronization of the measurements and devices for controlling of the monitored switch gears (remote control device). Components, maintenance, inspection and service of the network control technology form the remaining groups

name: Lighting installation, device
definition: lighting installation provides an optical illumination of a room or object with an artificial light. Artificial light sources or illuminants are lamps. Main group 27110000 is divided into interior and exterior lighting systems or interior luminaires, and those are subdivided into intended purpose and functional principle. Luminaires and lighting systems for usage in the ex-area form a separate group. Further systems, parts, components, maintenance, inspection and service of the lighting devices form the remaining groups

name: Substation automation
definition: Solution for controlling, signalingand controling. Substaion automation monitors various settings, including those for manufacturing equipment, controls switchgears and automates operating processes in medium and high voltage electrical substations (acc. International Electrotechnical Commission 61850)

name: Protection installation, device (electric)
definition: protection installation for electrical equipment is a device to avoid unintentional malfunctioning when generating, transferring, transforming and usage of electrical energy or electricity. Even equipment which shields electrical nets and devices from external disturbance is called protection installation. Main group 27130000 is structured according to generator protection installation and net protection installation of different requirements, aux. protection installation and surge protection devices of various specifications. Further systems, parts, components, maintenance, inspection and service of the protection devices form the remaining groups

name: Electrical installation, device
definition: Electrical installation is the erection of electrical devices for low voltage intending to supply the current for a house installation. This includes the routing of cables, the installation of routers, overcurrent protection devices, residual-current-operated protective devices, circuit breakers, illuminates, electrical devices, electrical machines, sensors, switches and socket outlets as well as the final measuring of the effectiveness of the safety measures and the check-up of the functionality and the interaction of all the installed components. Main group 27140000 is divided into the various components of the electrical installation, the installation system, connecting devices, signaling techniques, used bus systems and the equipment for remote control. Further division is by systems, parts, components, maintenance, inspection and service of the electrical installation components

name: Analysis technology, device
definition: Devices and technology for systematical measurement, fragmentation, examination and analysis of objects without neglecting the intertwining and integration of the singular analysed elements. It can be differentiated between qualitative, quantitative analysis methods for the clearance or identification of the structure within the various scientific areas. Main group 27150000 is divided into devices for analysis for the measurement of various physical sizes as well as the resulting measurements and complex attachments for the structure analysis of the materials. Further division is by systems, parts, components, maintenance, inspection and service of the analytic devices

name: Overhead line technology
definition: Overhead lines are the open landlines of the power circuit for the transmission of electrical energy. The technology of the overhead line includes non-insulated overhead line stranded conductor which are hung up with insulators on overhead line poles or towers. Often the transfer of information via transmission cable or optical-fibre cable in the conductor ropes is quite important. Main group 27160000 is divided according to the used construction materials of the overhead line poles and the material of the overhead lines and other overhead line technology, components, accessories, maintenance, inspection and service

name: Internal and external lightning protection
definition: Devices and components that are suitable by their design and approvals for use in and for the installation of lightning protection systems

name: Electrical cabinet, housing, rack
definition: Electrical cabinet houses the fixtures and structures of the range of capacity and control of the electrical and electronic components of a unit. It serves as an electric connector of the components with each other via clamps and plug connections, Furthermore the cabinet provides protection for the internal components against dust, moisture, overheating (air conditioning), electro-magnetic influence as well as mechanic influences (vandalism, earthquakes). Often there is a main switch for the close-down of the associated units in case of emergency. Main group 27180000 is divided according to the functions of the units whose components are in the cabinet, size, exterior appearance of the housing and the assembly site of the sub-rack. Furthermore included are control cabinets, casings, sub-racks, components and accessories

name: Empty enclosure
definition: Products that serve to protect internal components against moisture and solid foreign bodies as well as against mechanical influences

name: Measurement technology, process measurement technology
definition: measurement technique deals with devices and methods to define physical quantities as well as the recording, modelling and correction of errors of measurement and unwanted influences. It also includes the adjustment and calibration of measuring devices. Main group 27200000 is divided by means of physical quantities, measured by measuring devices, furthermore included is the category testing instruments, measurement techniques, components, accessories, maintenance, inspection and service of the (process) measurement technique

name: Signal processing
definition: Signal processing summarises all steps of processing for the acquisition of information from a received or measured signal. The most important aim is the reduction of data and the preparation of signals for the preparation of the transmission. There is a differentiation between digital and analogue signal processing as well as between one-dimensional (audio signals) two-dimensional (picture signals) and three-dimensional (video signals) signal processing. Main group 27210000 is divided into structural components and devices for signal and data acquisition (transducer, registration devices) and devices for signal processing according to different principles (converter, regulator).Further division is done by parts, components, maintenance, inspection and service of the signal processing devices

name: Actuator (fitting)
definition: Actuators are elements or technical appliances which transform an input parameter into a different output parameter. In the automatic control technique actuators define the converter-related counterpart to sensors and form the controlling elements in a control circuit. An armature defines a control element of a machine or valves, stopcocks and sliders (actuators) to control and regulate the material flow in technical systems. Main group 27220000 is structured into differently powered actuating drive, feedback units and magnetic valves. Furthermore there is a division into armatures, components, maintenance, inspection and service

name: Process control system (PCS)
definition: Process control systems are used for the conducting of a procedural installation and consist of process-oriented components which are connected via bus system, as well as control and monitoring stations. Process-oriented components are used for controlling and regulating tasks and are connected with sensors and actuators. Control and monitoring stations are used for the visualisation of the site for the site drivers. Main group 27230000 is divided into complete PCS- processors, their single components and complete systems of process control in buildings. Further PCSs, parts, accessories, assembly, maintenance, inspection and service form another group

name: Control, Process Control System (PCS)
definition: Controlling is the directed influence of the properties of a system from the outside by input. To that end information is to be transferred, processed and passed on via sensors. Main group 27240000 is divided into controlling devices of various function principles, control software and external devices (storage and field buses). Furthermore it is divided into parts, accessories, briefing, training, start-up, assembly, maintenance, inspection and service of control units

name: Terminal block system and system component
definition: Component and parts used for making detachable mechanical connection of electrical conductors or by the combination of which corresponding connections are made possible

name: Component (electronic)
definition: Components of an electronic circuitry or an assembly group, respectively electric structural elements in electronics. The division is carried out into ideal and real, passive and active, linear and non-linear as well as discrete and integrated components. The structural element can be seen as the smallest functional part of an electrical switch gear. Main group 27260000 consists of various parts classes and correlating connection elements. Further structural components, parts and accessories structure the other parts

name: Sensor technology, safety-related sensor technology
definition: Technical sensor technology deals with technical products which transforms non-electronic measured variables into electrical signals. In many cases unitary signals or field buses are applied in practice. The sensor technology takes a look at systems which are used for the preservation of a state, which should be as free from dangers as possible, of a technical system. Main group 27270000 is structured according to the operating principle of the different sensor groups, as far as this is possible

name: Identification
definition: Identification is the process which leads to the clear recognition of a person or an object. The identification is carried out by means of specific characteristic traits or with the help of an identifier by step-by-step matching. Main group 27280000 is divided into different principles of identification, further principles and accessories for the different identification techniques or identification devices

name: Image analysis
definition: Analysis and application of statistical methods as well as methods from a data processing point of view for the analysis of an image dataset under specified conditions or with specified aims. For this optics, sensors and software will be used. Main group 27310000 is divided into systems for image analysis, their single components, accessories and documentation of these systems and components

name: Industrial weighing technology
definition: Devices for the definition of a mass by its weight which is measured either directly or is compared with the weight of a known mass. A special form is the scale counter which defines the number of several identical items out of the mass of one or a few individual items. Calibration to the local gravity is necessary. Scales exist in mechanical and electronic versions. Main group 27320000 is subdivided into weighing systems of different principles, structural shapes and areas of application, furthermore into parts, accessories, briefing, training, start-up, maintenance, inspection and service

name: Display and control component
definition: Apparatuses for optical signalisation of states and values as well as input components for the controlling of the device by a human person. Apparatuses of visualisation can be mechanical, electro-mechanical, electrical or electronic and they are controlled by a specified software. Main group 27330000 is structured by display and control complete systems, software for display and control components, parts, accessories, maintenance, inspection, service and repair of the components

name: Low-voltage switch technology
definition: Low-voltage switch technology is used for the operation of low voltage (it used to be heavy current equipment) which operates with an alternating current of under 1kV. Low-voltage switch technology consists of operating devices for producing, generating, storing, transmitting, allocating and consumption of electric energy. The standards necessary for the set-up, handling and maintenance of low voltage are established in German standards. Main group 27370000 is subdivided according to all operating devices of low voltage including preservatives and monitoring devices. Furthermore there is a division of parts, accessories, documentation, maintenance, inspection and service/repair

name: Robotics, Assembly
definition: Core area of robotics is the development and control of robots which interact with the physical world based on sensors, actuators and information processing. Mechanical modelling, adjustment control and the electronic control system are essential for that. Handling technique defines a device which handles the flow of material from or to a pace of activity, respectively provides a defined orientation of the workpiece. Main group 27380000 is subdivided into robot types with different fields of application and functions as well as their control units, implementations and simulation. Furthermore there are groups which contain miscellaneous, parts, accessories, briefing, training, assembly, maintenance, inspection, and service of robots and handling technique

name: Property, access monitor
definition: Monitoring of a property or a room by use of cameras and other sensors or the control of admission by a set of regulations with the result that only entitled people have access to the sections which are open to them, either in buildings or secured areas on a compound. The right of access can be temporarily limited can be controlled by human guards or by a technical access control system on the basis of proof of identity. Main group 27390000 consists of access control systems/ time registration systems, intrusion protection technology/ burglar alarm systems as well as their maintenance, inspection and servicing

name: Electrical insulation and connecting material
definition: Insulation materials are hardly or non- conductible materials used for prevention of electrical current flow between voltage-carrying and conducting parts which do not carry voltage. They have a high electric disruptive strength and a low water absorbency. The insulation of cables is made from insulating materials. Connecting materials are used for the creation of an electric contact between two electrodes with the aim to conduct an electric current. The contact resistance resulting from that should be as little as possible. Main group 27400000 is subdivided into various cable mountings and their equipment for installation, labelling and the specification of the protective circuit. Furthermore this main group is subdivided into miscellaneous, parts and accessories

name: Electronic coil and filter
definition: Electronic coils are inductive passive structuring elements which are used for attenuation of unwanted frequencies or for storage of energy in the area of electric power supply of electrical or electronic devices or attachments. Disturbing pulses and alternating current parts in direct currents are suppressed and it is possible to separate alternating currents of different frequencies. Electric filters define switch gears which an electrical signal transforms depending on the frequency of amplitude and phase. As a result unwanted signal parts are weakened or suppressed. Main group 27420000 is separated into electronic coils and electrical filters for the low-voltage range

name: Cable, pipe, hose laying (electric installation)
definition: Laying of cables in the electrical installation is done by means of an installation tube, conduit or cable protection tube and its accessories for the protection of cables and conductors against mechanical and other influences

name: Connector system
definition: this category encompasses systems designed to establish electrical connections between various components or devices within electrical engineering applications. It includes a range of elements that facilitate the transmission of power and signals, ensuring reliable communication and functionality in automation and control processes. The classification includes various types of connectors and associated components that serve distinct purposes in connection management, ranging from simple plug connections to more complex integration solutions. This classification is crucial for understanding the diverse applications and technologies involved in connecting electrical systems, supporting effective design and implementation in various sectors of automation and process control engineering.

name: Electrostatic charge
definition: Devices that specifically influence the electricstatic charge of objects

name: PCB connection technology
definition: Pluggable as well as non-pluggable components used with PCB connection technology

name: Semifinished product (plastic)
definition: prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form made of plastic

name: Semifinished product (other material)
definition: Prefabricated workpiece (or raw material mould) of the simplest form in which the proportion of any other material (such as glass, ceramics, etc.) is greater than 50%

name: Semifinished product (paper)
definition: Paper products for further processing Remark: Further processing substantially consists in printing, cutting and molding

name: Semi-finished product (steel)
definition: prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of iron metal is greater than 50%

name: Semi-finished product (aluminum)
definition: Prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of aluminum is greater than 50%

name: Semi-finished product (copper)
definition: Prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of copper is greater than 50%

name: Semi-finished product (titan)
definition: Prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of titanium is greater than 50%

name: Semi-finished product (nickel)
definition: Prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of nickel is greater than 50%

name: Semi-finished product (other non-ferrous metal)
definition: Prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of other non-ferrous metal is greater than 50%

name: Semi-finished product (brass)
definition: prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of brass is greater than 50%

name: Semi-finished product (stainless steel)
definition: prefabricated workpiece (or raw material form) of the simplest form, in which the proportion of iron metal is greater than 50%

name: Metal or plastic fitting
definition: this classification encompasses a variety of components designed for the connection, regulation, and management of fluid flow within industrial piping systems. It includes devices that facilitate the control of pressure, flow, and direction, ensuring efficient operation and safety in various applications. The components may be constructed from a range of materials, including both metal and plastic, to suit different environmental conditions and operational requirements. Additionally, this classification covers fittings designed for specialized functions such as sampling, draining, and pressure regulation, contributing to the overall performance and reliability of piping systems in industrial settings.

name: Pipe system (steel)
definition: this classification encompasses a category of systems designed for the conveyance of fluids or gases, constructed primarily from steel materials. These systems are engineered for durability and strength, facilitating efficient transportation in various industrial applications. The components within this category include various types of pipes, fittings, and connections specifically tailored for steel construction. The classification distinguishes these systems from alternatives made of different materials, ensuring a clear identification of those that utilize steel as a primary resource. This category serves as a comprehensive reference for professionals seeking to understand and utilize steel piping systems in industrial settings, focusing on their specific applications and functionalities.

name: Pipe system (non-ferrous metal)
definition: Tubes, fitting and connections for aluminium, copper, brass piping

name: Pipe system (enameled)
definition: this classification encompasses systems designed for the transportation of fluids, specifically those that are coated with an enamel finish to enhance durability and resistance to corrosion. These systems are typically utilized in industrial settings where the integrity and longevity of piping are crucial. The classification distinguishes itself from other types of piping systems by focusing on the unique properties and applications of enamel-coated pipes. It includes various configurations and components that facilitate the effective conveyance of liquids and gases while ensuring compliance with industry standards for safety and performance. The classification aims to provide clarity in the identification and selection of these specialized piping systems within industrial applications.

name: Pipe system (glass)
definition: this classification encompasses systems and components specifically designed for the transportation of fluids using glass materials. It includes various types of pipes, fittings, and associated elements that are engineered to ensure efficient and safe fluid conveyance in diverse applications. The focus is on products made from glass, emphasizing their unique properties such as transparency, chemical resistance, and suitability for high-purity applications. This category features items that facilitate the integration of glass piping into existing systems, allowing for seamless connections and reliable operation. It serves industries that require specialized piping solutions, highlighting the importance of durability, compatibility, and installation ease in glass-based piping systems.

name: Pipe system (thermoplastic)
definition: this classification encompasses systems designed for the transportation of fluids, gases, or other materials using components made primarily from thermoplastic materials. These systems are distinguished by their flexibility, resistance to corrosion, and ability to maintain structural integrity under various environmental conditions. The elements within this classification include specialized connections, joints, and fittings that ensure reliable and efficient operation in industrial applications. The systems are tailored for use in diverse sectors, offering advantages such as lightweight construction and ease of installation, making them suitable for a wide range of applications where traditional materials may not be ideal.

name: Hose piping
definition: this category encompasses flexible conduits designed to transport liquids, gases, or other substances, typically featuring a cylindrical form that allows for bending and maneuverability. These conduits are often made from various materials to enhance durability and compatibility with different applications. The offerings in this category range from unconnected hoses to completed assemblies, incorporating various types of connections and fittings to facilitate integration with existing systems. This classification is distinguished by its focus on the specific nature of the flexible conduits and their associated components, rather than rigid piping systems or fittings, ensuring clarity in the identification and selection of appropriate products for diverse industrial applications.

name: Pipe system (lined)
definition: this classification encompasses a category of interconnected structures designed for the transportation of fluids or gases, specifically featuring a lined interior that enhances performance and durability. These systems are engineered to accommodate specific operational requirements, providing resistance to corrosion, abrasion, and chemical degradation. The components within this category include flanges, lined pipes, and fittings that contribute to the integrity and functionality of the overall piping system. Each element is designed to ensure optimal flow characteristics while maintaining compatibility with various industrial applications. This classification is distinct from other piping solutions that may involve different materials or configurations, focusing specifically on the advantages offered by lining materials in enhancing the longevity and reliability of the piping infrastructure.

name: Pipe system (thermosetting plastic, GRP)
definition: this category encompasses systems designed for the transportation of fluids or gases, specifically utilizing thermosetting plastics or glass-reinforced plastics (GRP) as the primary materials. These systems are characterized by their ability to withstand high temperatures and pressures, making them suitable for a variety of industrial applications. The components within this classification include flanges, pipes, and fittings crafted from thermosetting plastic or GRP, along with fully assembled piping solutions that are ready for installation. This classification distinctly differentiates itself from other piping systems that utilize alternative materials such as metals or thermoplastics, and it is tailored for applications requiring enhanced durability and resistance to environmental factors.

name: Pipeline technology (pneumatics)
definition: this classification encompasses technologies and components related to the transmission of energy and control through gases under pressure. It includes elements designed for the efficient movement and management of pneumatic systems, facilitating the functionality of various industrial applications. The classification features essential fittings and connections that ensure the integrity and performance of pneumatic lines, hoses, and other related components. This category also covers specialized items such as clutches and flanges, which are integral to the assembly and operation of pneumatic systems. Emphasis is placed on the compatibility, reliability, and safety of these components within a broader industrial piping framework, ensuring optimal operation in diverse environments.

name: Pipeline technology (hydraulics)
definition: this classification encompasses technologies and components specifically designed for the management and transportation of fluids under pressure within hydraulic systems. It includes a range of elements that facilitate the efficient transfer of hydraulic fluids, ensuring optimal performance and safety in various applications. The classification covers fittings, lines, hoses, clutches, and flanges tailored for hydraulic use, each serving distinct functions in the overall system. The focus is on technology that enhances the reliability and functionality of hydraulic piping systems, distinguishing it from other piping technologies that may serve different mediums or purposes. This classification serves industries requiring specialized hydraulic solutions for effective fluid handling and system integration.

name: Pipeline technology (vacuum)
definition: this category encompasses technology and components specifically designed for pipeline applications operating under vacuum conditions. It includes various fittings and connections that facilitate the safe and efficient transport of gases or liquids in a vacuum environment. The offerings in this classification feature specialized products engineered to maintain the integrity of vacuum systems, ensuring minimal leakage and optimal performance. The range includes items such as vacuum fittings, vacuum lines, pressure tubing, vacuum couplings, and vacuum flanges, all of which are tailored for use in industrial applications where maintaining a vacuum is critical. This classification is distinct from other technologies that handle different types of piping systems, whether they are made from metal, plastic, or other materials, and focuses solely on those components that cater to vacuum technology needs.

name: Pipe connection for metallic piping
definition: covers special piping connections like screwed fitting, which are used as complete systems. Flanges and flanged joints are not part of this class

name: Expansion joint, absorber
definition: this classification refers to components designed to accommodate movement, absorb vibrations, and reduce stress in piping systems. These elements are essential in preventing damage to pipelines by allowing for thermal expansion, contraction, and other dynamic forces that occur during operation. The components within this classification are specifically engineered for use in industrial applications, facilitating the seamless integration and functionality of complex piping arrangements. This category encompasses a variety of designs and materials, ensuring compatibility with different types of pipe systems while providing reliable performance under various operational conditions.

name: Pipe system (pre-insulated)
definition: this classification encompasses systems designed for the transport of fluids or gases, featuring thermal insulation to enhance energy efficiency and reduce heat loss. These systems are primarily utilized in industrial applications, ensuring optimal performance in environments where temperature regulation is critical. The classification includes various components that facilitate the assembly and functionality of insulated pipelines, as well as connections that maintain the integrity of the system. The focus is on pre-insulated solutions that cater to specific operational requirements in industrial settings, differentiating them from other types of piping systems that do not feature the same level of insulation or are made from alternative materials. This classification serves as a comprehensive guide for identifying and categorizing pre-insulated piping solutions and their associated fittings and connections.

name: Optical material
definition: Material that has main properties usable for optical imaging

name: Optical component
definition: Part providing a function in optical imaging

name: Optical assembly
definition: Functional unit consisting of several optical components

name: Mounted optic
definition: At least one optical component or optical assembly mounted in a mechanical mount / holder

name: Optical instrument
definition: Instrument whose function is mainly based on optical phenomena, consisting of several assemblies and/or components, illumination systems, instruments with light conduction and instruments which, apart from optical units, contain assemblies and/or components from other fields, e.g. electronic components

name: Actuator (pneumatics)
definition: constructive unit in pneumatics, which moves a machine by means of energy transformation

name: Handling (pneumatics)
definition: system or drive specially designed for handling tasks

name: Valve (pneumatics)
definition: component for controlling or blocking the flow of air

name: Valve module (pneumatics)
definition: valve block or height chaining

name: Compressed air preparation (pneumatics)
definition: part of a pneumatic system in which the compressed air for the operation of the system is processed

name: Vacuum technology (pneumatics)
definition: deals with devices and methods for creating, maintaining and measuring a vacuum as well as technical application of the vacuum

name: Pneumatic connection technology (pneumatics)
definition: connecting component, which allows the flow of the pressure medium between the components

name: Pneumatic and electropneumatic control system (pneumatics)
definition: control with pneumatic and / or electrical components

name: Documentation and Software (pneumatics)
definition: user documentation and software for various applications

name: Pump (hydraulics)
definition: work machine for converting mechanical ernergy into hydraulic energy

name: Motor (hydraulics)
definition: actuator that provides rotary motion

name: Transmission (hydraulics)
definition: combination of one or more hydraulic displacement units

name: Switching valve (hydraulics)
definition: component that controls the direction, pressure or flow rate of fluid

name: Continuous control valve (hydraulics)
definition: valve that controls the flow of energy of a system in a continuous way in response to a continuous input signal NOTE This encompasses all types of servo-valves and proportional control valves

name: Two-port slip-in cartridge valve (hydraulics)
definition: valve, designed as Two-port slip-in cartridge, that controls the direction, pressure or flow rate of fluid

name: Control system (hydraulics)
definition: arrangement of interconnected hydraulic components which controls hydraulic energy

name: Cylinder, electro hydraulic actuator, self contained actuator (hydraulics)
definition: actuator that provides linear motion, with or without control unit, with or without motor-pump unit

name: Power unit (hydraulics)
definition: assembly of a prime mover, pump with or without a reservoir and accessories

name: Hydraulic accumulator (hydraulics)
definition: Component for storing and releasing hydrostatic energy

name: Filter (hydraulics)
definition: component that retains contaminants from fluid on the basis of particle size

name: Piping (hydraulics)
definition: any combination of connectors, couplings, tubes and/or hoses which allows fluid flow between components

name: Heating technology (hydraulics)
definition: Field of hydraulics dealing with the production and application of heat

name: Electronics and software (hydraulics)
definition: hardware and programmes for operating electrical and electronic devices

name: Machine-/device handle
definition: Component, usually for machines, tools and devices, which is used for manual clamping, tightening, loosening, pulling or pushing

name: Hand wheel / Crank handle (machine handle)
definition: Component, usually for machines, tools and devices that is used to manually transfer movements to shafts and spindles

name: Lever (machine handle)
definition: Lever-shaped component, usually for machines, tools and devices, which is used for manual clamping, tightening or loosening

name: Quick release fastener
definition: Component, usually for machines, tools and devices, which is used for manual locking by insertion into cylindrical bores or which is used to open and lock moving components by means of a rotary movement

name: Leveling feet, leveling mount
definition: Component, usually for machines and devices, with which height adjustment is possible by rotating a movable component and, if necessary, level compensation by swiveling the component, which stands on a fixed base

name: Machine handle (other)
definition: Group (3rd level) for objects that cannot be classified into other specified groups in the existing structure, but that are classified to their parent-class on the 2nd level. A xx-xx-90-00-class cannot have any other sub-groups besides the generic xx-xx-90-90-class (…(Other, unspecified)) to be generally valid within the parent class on the 2nd level

name: Cardan shaft
definition: a specialized component designed to transmit torque and rotational motion between different parts of a mechanical system while accommodating misalignment. This type of shaft is characterized by its unique design that allows for flexibility and movement, ensuring efficient operation in various applications. It includes various fittings and joints that facilitate connection and compatibility with other mechanical elements. The classification encompasses variations that address specific functional requirements, such as those with or without length compensation and those featuring dual articulation. This classification is distinct from other types of shafts or connections that may serve different mechanical functions or configurations.

name: Profiled shaft
definition: a cylindrical or elongated mechanical component designed to transmit rotational force and motion, typically characterized by a cross-sectional profile that differs from standard shapes. This type of component can feature various lengths and diameters, and may incorporate specific design elements to enhance performance, such as improved strength or reduced weight. It is commonly used in various applications where precise alignment and stability are crucial. The defining characteristics of this component set it apart from similar types of mechanical shafts, allowing it to fulfill distinct roles in machinery and equipment. Examples of this classification include variations designed as tubular structures or shorter, stub configurations.

name: Splineshaft
definition: a category that encompasses a specific type of mechanical element characterized by its elongated form and a series of grooves or ridges along its surface. This type of element is designed to transmit torque and rotational motion between components, facilitating the connection and alignment of machinery parts. It differs from similar elements by its unique design features and operational functions, ensuring effective performance in various applications. The items classified under this category are generally utilized in the construction of machinery and equipment, contributing to their efficient operation and reliability.

name: Shaft-hub-connection
definition: this classification encompasses various mechanisms and components designed to facilitate the secure attachment and alignment of shafts to hubs, ensuring efficient power transmission and rotational motion. It includes systems and devices that employ locking mechanisms to maintain the integrity of the connection under operational stresses. The classification is distinct from other shaft-related categories, focusing specifically on the unique characteristics and functionalities of shaft-hub connections. It covers a range of locking elements and systems, both internal and external, that are essential for achieving reliable and stable connections in mechanical assemblies.

name: Shaft (turbo machine)
definition: this classification encompasses components specifically designed for use in turbo machinery, relating to the transmission of rotational movement and power. These items are typically characterized by their cylindrical shape and are engineered to withstand significant mechanical stress and torque. They play a critical role in the operation of turbo machines, providing essential links between various machine parts to facilitate efficient motion transfer. The classification includes specialized shafts that serve unique functions within compressor systems, such as those used for pinion and bull gear applications, distinguishing them from other types of shafts and connections that may be utilized in different mechanical contexts.

name: Rotor (turbo machine)
definition: a rotor designed for integration within turbo machines is a crucial component that facilitates the conversion of energy. This essential part typically consists of a rotating assembly that includes blades or vanes, which interact with a fluid or gas to perform work. Rotors are engineered to withstand significant mechanical and thermal stresses, ensuring optimal performance and efficiency. They play a vital role in various applications, contributing to the overall functionality of turbo machinery, such as enhancing the flow and pressure of gases or fluids. This classification encompasses various types of rotors specifically tailored for use in compressors and turbines, highlighting their distinct characteristics and applications in energy conversion processes.

name: Shaft joint, shaft joint component
definition: component for movable connection of shafts and components for the joints

name: Shaft, shaft joint (other)
definition: Group (3rd level) for objects that cannot be classified into other specified groups in the existing structure, but that are classified to their parent-class on the 2nd level. A xx-xx-90-00-class cannot have any other sub-groups besides the generic xx-xx-90-90-class (…(Other, unspecified)) to be generally valid within the parent class on the 2nd level

name: Coupling (rigid)
definition: this classification encompasses mechanical connections designed to join two shafts or components in a rigid manner, ensuring torque transmission without any relative movement between the connected parts. Such couplings are essential in various engineering applications where precision and stability are required, typically characterized by their ability to resist misalignment and maintain a fixed relationship between the connected elements. The specific types included in this classification represent different designs and functionalities, catering to a range of operational requirements. Each type is engineered to provide reliable performance in transmitting power while minimizing wear and enhancing the longevity of the connected components.

name: Coupling (torsionally stiff)
definition: this category encompasses mechanical devices designed to connect two shafts in a manner that ensures the transfer of rotational motion and torque while maintaining a high degree of stiffness under torsional loads. These connectors are engineered to minimize relative motion between the shafts, thereby enhancing the precision and efficiency of power transmission. They are primarily utilized in various applications where rigid connections are essential for operational integrity and performance, distinguishing them from other types of connectors that allow for flexibility, engagement, or disengagement under certain conditions. The items classified within this category include various types of couplings that are tailored to meet specific engineering requirements while ensuring durability and reliability in demanding environments.

name: Coupling (elastic)
definition: this classification encompasses flexible connection devices designed to transmit torque between shafts while accommodating misalignment and reducing vibration. These components are characterized by their ability to deform under load, allowing for the absorption of shocks and vibrations, which enhances operational efficiency and extends the lifespan of connected machinery. The devices within this category include various types of elastic couplings, each tailored to provide specific performance attributes, such as high elasticity or torsional flexibility, while maintaining effective power transmission. These couplings are essential in applications where flexibility and resilience are critical for optimal performance and reliability.

name: Coupling (engaging and disengaging)
definition: this classification encompasses devices designed to connect and disconnect mechanical elements, enabling the transmission of power or motion in a controlled manner. These devices are specifically engineered for engaging and disengaging operations, which may be actuated through various mechanisms such as mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or electromagnetic means. This category distinguishes itself from other forms of connection that are either rigid, torsionally stiff, elastic, or permanent and non-engaging. Additionally, it excludes specialized couplings that incorporate sensors or those designed for overload protection. The focus here is on clutches and similar mechanisms that facilitate variable engagement, allowing for the modulation of force and motion transfer in mechanical systems.

name: Coupling (Permanent-magnetic, non-engaging)
definition: this classification encompasses various types of connections that utilize permanent-magnetic mechanisms to create a stable link between two rotating elements without the need for engagement or disengagement. These connections are designed to transmit power and motion efficiently while minimizing wear and friction. Unlike other connection types, this category is characterized by its non-engaging nature, ensuring a consistent performance in applications where constant alignment and torque transfer are essential.
